description: Ändring av handlingar — changing a förfrågningsunderlag or a bygghandling should be done consistently and clearly, so that there is no uncertainty about what has been changed.

drawing_change_markers.intro_en: That a drawing has been changed is stated:

places.en: on the drawing at the point of change (in a revision 'cloud')
in the revision table of the drawing's title block

places.sv: på ritningens namnruta i plats för ändringsbeteckning
places.en: in the title block, in the space for the revision designation
in the document list / drawing list
in the KFU or the PM

text_document_change_markers.intro_en: That a beskrivning (text document) has been changed is stated:

places.en: in the text document at the point of change
on all pages of the text document
on the title page of the text document
in the KFU or the PM

accompanying_documents.note_en: Normally attached when tender documents are changed.
Attached when a construction document is changed. KFU and PM are numbered in the same sequence.

takeoff_implication: A takeoff pipeline must version drawings by ändringsbeteckning (A, B, C, D ...) and re-run affected quantities when a KFU or Ändrings-PM is issued. Revision clouds mark the regions to re-measure.
